name: io.github.letoribo/mcp-graphql-enhanced
description: GraphQL gateway for LLMs. Handles huge GitHub GraphQL & @neo4j/graphql schemas without crashing

environmentVariables.name: ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: GraphQL endpoint(s). Supports comma-separated list for Multi-Node Architecture.

environmentVariables.name: HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: JSON string containing headers for requests.

environmentVariables.name: SCHEMA
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local GraphQL schema file or URL.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Enable HTTP transport: auto (default), true, or false.
